title: Mood Metric0 High Value Outliers
dataSources: Mood entries (`mood:entry`), meditation sessions (`meditation:session`), journal entries (`journal:entry`), gratitude logs (`gratitude:log`).
app: Mood, mindfulness and journaling apps — Daylio / How We Feel mood exports, Headspace / Insight Timer meditation logs, journaling and gratitude entries — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mood:metric0 value=*
| eventstats perc90(value) as p90, perc10(value) as p10
| where value>=p90 OR value<=p10
| table _time source_id value p90 p10
description: Surfaces the highest and lowest value outliers in mood metric0 events.
value: Tail events often explain spikes in cost, effort, or risk that averages hide.
implementation: Compute percentile bands on `value` and review extreme mood metric0 records.
visualization: Scatter plot of value with percentile bands.
grandmaExplanation: It keeps the unusually high or low value moments in your mood metric0 history.
